name: locka-snap
prompt: Locked-off studio shot. After a short pause the steel shackle of the padlock drops straight down and snaps shut into the brass body with a firm click, a tiny recoil, then the padlock hangs perfectly still, locked. The green rim light flares briefly at the moment it locks. Camera completely still.

name: clockb-spin
prompt: Locked-off studio shot. The two clock hands spin forward very fast and smoothly around the dial, like a full day passing in seconds, the minute hand sweeping many full turns, the hour hand turning steadily. The green glowing ring pulses gently. The clock itself and the camera stay completely still.
